title: Keep all E2E specs covered and rebalance the six CI shards

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-130#rebalance-ci-e2e-shards

Verdict: Insufficient evidence. Scratch dependency setup failed before a maintained passing baseline, so no fault was applied and no assertion verdict is established.

Story and revision: SEED-130, “Keep all E2E specs covered and rebalance the six CI shards,” at 499a16d4eff7bbb6b70b0c9d8768cad29681480c. The selected promise is that an eligible learning-session file runs once through the remainder. The intended check was the actual selector CLI case in scripts/ci/e2e-shards.test.mjs, “workflow slots partition checkout specs and select the learning-session file in the remainder.” Its assertPartition comparison and explicit learning-session inclusion assertion were inspected. The suggested fault would omit learning_session from the remainder in scripts/ci/e2e-shards.mjs; fixtures and assertions would stay unchanged.

Setup and observations: Created an isolated detached scratch checkout at the selected revision, initially clean. ./scripts/run.sh bash scripts/worktree_setup.sh failed during locked dependency installation: Cypress postinstall could not resolve fs-extra/lib/index.js; canvas also attempted a native fallback without pkg-config. The /tmp checkout selected /private/tmp/.pnpm-store/v11. One bounded recovery used the existing machine-level package cache with CI=true ./scripts/run.sh pnpm --store-dir /Users/terryyin/.pnpm-store --frozen-lockfile recursive install. It reused 1118 packages but again failed Cypress postinstall on the same missing fs-extra entry point. No mutable installation was copied or symlinked, and setup was not bypassed.

The intended maintained command, ./scripts/run.sh node --test scripts/ci/e2e-shards.test.mjs, did not run. Reach, independently observed wrong selection and a maintained assertion catch are therefore unproved. No temporary source edit or fault was introduced. Scratch Git state remained exactly its initial clean state; the owned scratch worktree and its isolated dependencies were removed. The execution checkout was not edited by this check.

Next proof action: obtain a successful locked installation in an isolated scratch checkout, then run the passing-baseline / one-fault / restored-pass loop for the remainder-selection promise. This report makes no test-repair decision and does not invalidate the already observed delivery proof; the caller owns follow-up disposition.

Prior disposition: no already-planned test repair was identified for this promise. This is an environment/setup limitation of the attempted probe, not a newly observed product failure.

Costs:
- Test runtime: unavailable — no maintained test runner launched because setup failed before baseline.
- Human effort: unavailable — no separately measured human-effort record for this probe.
- Agent effort: unavailable — no independent active-effort meter; elapsed time is measured separately below.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 165643 ms (measured), from 1794797059921 to 1794797225564 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition — checked revision 499a16d4eff7bbb6b70b0c9d8768cad29681480c: Insufficient evidence; no fault or assertion/path gap was observed. The probe remains inconclusive. Existing maintained actual-CLI partition/new-directory/tag checks and exact six-part hosted CI independently establish the delivered promise. No new or stronger product proof or test correction is required for closure; no follow-up is queued. A future optional probe retry needs a healthy isolated locked install. Scratch restoration and retirement are confirmed.
